# bugs #3836: mcs51: error 129 for comparing the address of a local variable with a generic pointer

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/3836/
- Category: [Fixes that need a decision](../../fix-decision.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17176
- Recommended action: Confirm the generic pointer as common type and its code-size cost, then apply. ds390 was not built.
- Patch: [bugs-3836.patch](../../patches/bugs-3836.patch), commit [`459299426`](https://github.com/mdmower/sdcc/commit/45929942660ea2f855b21bec73bc4012730b0175). Applies to r17176 without the other patches.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

For mcs51, sdcc rejects `&var != null` in `support/regression/tests/bug-3830.c` with error 129.
`var` is a local `char`, and `null` is a `char *`. In trunk the test is disabled for mcs51 and
ds390. The comparison compiles when the operands are exchanged. The error was reproduced for mcs51
only.

## Cause

`computeType` in `src/SDCCsymt.c` returns the type of the left operand whenever that operand is a
pointer. `&var` has the type `char near*`, and `null` is a generic pointer, so the common type is
the near pointer. `usualBinaryConversions` then converts the generic pointer to it implicitly.
`checkPtrCast` gives error 129 for an implicit conversion from a generic pointer to a pointer into
one address space. It makes this test on the ports where `GPTRSIZE > FARPTRSIZE`.

## Fix

`computeType` returns the type of the right operand when the left operand is an object pointer
that is not generic and the right operand is a generic object pointer. Function pointers keep the
rule of trunk. The patch enables `bug-3830.c` for mcs51.

## Decision

The common type of a generic pointer and a pointer into one address space is the generic pointer
for either operand order, and the conversion gets no warning. This is the proposal in the ticket's
description. The second comment proposes to convert the null pointer when the generic pointer is
known to be null. In `bug-3830.c` the generic pointer is a variable.

The choice increases code size in one case. When the right operand is a `void *`, trunk converts
it to the type of the left operand, which `checkPtrCast` allows without a diagnostic, and compares
only the bytes of that type. With the patch the comparison covers all bytes of the generic
pointer. The regression test `memory` grows by 768 bytes for mcs51 in the small model. On stm8 and
z80, the code of two or three regression tests changes by a few bytes.

`computeType` also determines the type of `c ? xp : g`. The patch gives this expression the generic
type when `xp` points into one address space and `g` is generic.

ds390 was not built. `bug-3830.c` stays disabled for ds390, and by the code the change applies to
ds390 as well.

## Verification

`bug-3830.c` does not compile for mcs51 without the patch and passes with it.
`support/regression/tests/bug-3836.c` compares the address of a local variable and an `__xdata`
pointer with generic pointers in both operand orders, and it tests the `?:` case.
